insights: NVIDIA's design system relies heavily on their signature green (#76B900) as the sole accent color against a stark black/white palette, making CTAs and interactive elements instantly recognizable across all page sections.
The page extensively uses accordion patterns with Quick Links toggles in each content section, providing progressive disclosure while keeping the main content scannable.

Animation patterns are subtle and functional - cascading fade-ins for search results and AI content generation feedback create a polished, responsive feel without overwhelming the technical content focus.
